scientific_scope: simulated WDM to simulated Bell fidelity only
fresh_seed_rule: Every confirmatory evaluation seed is disjoint from v5.25 and from the v5.26 methodology-debug run that exposed the BBPSSW target mismatch; each frozen policy uses only that seed's fit and temporal calibration prefix before its held-out suffix is evaluated.
multiplicity_correction: Holm over three exact paired seed-level sign-flip tests

policy_calibration.uncertainty_rule: Use the calibration-only upper quantile implied by the safety abstention budget; OOD remains an independent fail-closed condition.
policy_calibration.margin_rule: Maximize normalized utility on calibration samples subject to the policy WAIT budget; deterministic ties prefer less WAIT then the smaller margin.

task_semantics.link_purification: HALT/WAIT/PURIFY; prediction means future fidelity of each raw same-link pair, the raw-input eligibility boundary is obtained by analytically inverting BBPSSW for the declared output target, and pair values are used only to establish resource count.
task_semantics.path_extension: HALT/WAIT/SWAP; exactly two explicit stored link-pair fidelities determine predicted swap output and WDM candidate prediction is ignored.
task_semantics.legacy_policy: Retained as a compatibility control and not modified or used as the remediated policy.

claim_limit: No measured WDM or measured quantum target is used. Utility weights are normalized research choices, not currency or hardware measurements. No winner or threshold is selected on held-out results, and no physical action is performed.
